messages:
Asha (People Ops): Thanks for joining the All-Hands follow-up thread. Putting clarifications on a few recurring Qs so managers have consistent answers in 1:1s.

Eli (Eng Manager): First: will there be any promo freeze this quarter? Someone asked about hiring slowdowns and if that affects promotions.

Asha (People Ops): No promo freeze. We evaluate promotions on merit. If we need capacity-driven constraints that would be communicated in advance. For now, continue with normal cycle.

Dana (SWE): How does parental leave affect the review cycle? A teammate was worried time away would count against them.

Asha (People Ops): Parental leave is not penalized. Use the "time-off annotation" in the packet to note leave dates. Committee will account for approved leave when assessing scope and recent contribution window.

Eli (Eng Manager): If someone shifted roles mid-cycle (e.g., moved to tech lead), which level do we calibrate against?

Asha (People Ops): Calibrate against the role the person held for the majority of the cycle. If the move is material, add a note and a short before/after impact summary. We can also flag for mid-cycle special review.

Liam (Benefits): Quick comp ops: market adjustments due to relocation should include local market data and proposed USD equivalent. Locality cases are reviewed with comp committee.

Dana (SWE): Are equity refreshers automatic on promotion? Follow-up: if not, how to request?

Asha (People Ops): Equity refreshers are not automatic. Managers should check the "equity request" box in the calibration template and add rationale. Equity committee reviews with comp.

Eli (Eng Manager): Appeals process timeline? People want clarity on how to submit and timing.

Asha (People Ops): Letters go out 2026-06-10, appeals open for 14 calendar days. Appeals require manager note + rationale; HR will triage and bring cases to a small appeals panel.

PeopleBot: Reminder: calibration template due in 6 days for teams in the Southern region. :pushpin:

Sam (CEO): Managers: be explicit about next steps and measurable growth targets if someone isn't promoted. Leadership supports investment when the case merits it.

Eli (Eng Manager): One last ask  can we get a one-page script for return-to-work conversations after leave?

Asha (People Ops): Yes  adding a short return-to-work script and a 3-point growth plan template to the manager packet. Will post to handbook by 2026-06-04.

Asha (People Ops): Action items: manager script + return-to-work guide by 2026-06-04; upload calibration packets to /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026; letters 2026-06-10; appeals 14 days. Ping me or Liam for urgent cases. :sparkles:
